#!/bin/bash
# calib_ok <device> <today YYYY-MM-DD>: succeeds only while the device's calibration is valid
# (the due date itself is still valid). Devices missing from the records are NOT valid.
# Records: $CALIB (default data/calibration.tsv next to lib/).
calib_ok() {
  local file=${CALIB:-$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../data/calibration.tsv} due
  [[ "$2" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$ ]] || return 1
  due=$(awk -F'\t' -v d="$1" '$1 == d { print $2; exit }' "$file" 2>/dev/null)

  [[ ! "$due" < "$2" ]]
}

README.md.text:
# Lab equipment loans
実験室の機器の貸出記録。
- `bin/checkout <機器> <利用者> <今日 YYYY-MM-DD>`: 貸出を data/loans.tsv に追記する（環境変数 LOANS で別のファイル）
- `bin/return <機器>` / `bin/onloan`
機器の一覧は data/devices.tsv、校正記録は data/calibration.tsv（機器<TAB>校正期限日。環境変数 CALIB で別のファイル）。

bin/checkout.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: checkout <device> <user> <today YYYY-MM-DD>
# Appends device<TAB>user<TAB>date to $LOANS (default data/loans.tsv).
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
loans=${LOANS:-$root/data/loans.tsv}
source "$root/lib/calib.sh"
if ! CALIB=${CALIB:-$root/data/calibration.tsv} calib_ok "$1" "$3"; then
  echo "error: $1 is past its calibration date or has no calibration record; not checked out" >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" >> "$loans"
echo "checked out $1 to $2"

bin/onloan.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: onloan. Devices currently on loan, by device id.
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
sort "${LOANS:-$root/data/loans.tsv}"
